title: C gradient: implement post-step-6 minimum-SF floors a-d (spec 02a 2a.8)
description: Child of b7z9.30. Spec 2a.8: after step 6, the Downgrade (MUST increase SF) column applies as minimum-SF floors in order: a. EMA_SNR < -5 THEN SF=12; b. EMA_SNR < 0 THEN SF=MAX(11,SF); c. Density > 8 THEN SF=MAX(11,SF); d. LoadFactor > 0.8 THEN SF=MAX(11,SF). Absent from lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/gradient.c lichen_gradient_sf_select. Needs a load_factor input (function currently lacks one — signature change; check callers incl. Rust FFI and TDMA). Order matters (a then b then c then d, each MAX against the running SF). Unit tests per floor + combined. Land after the step-3 threshold child. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.30.
